highlights.title: Hear new agent messages read aloud
highlights.line: Turn on conversation mode beside the mic in a direct message or project room, and each new agent message there is read aloud.

highlights.title: A task and its subtasks stay with one agent
highlights.line: Once an agent holds a task, its subtasks stay with that agent, never handed to a second one, and the task list names the owner.

highlights.title: A missed repeating run gets done
highlights.line: When a repeating task's run is due, the nudge an idle agent gets names that run, so a missed one is done and recorded.

highlights.title: Take-backs say when a copy may still be up
highlights.line: Your list of community posts now says when a post you took back may still be public, instead of showing it as gone.
